blocks.text: מַלְכֵּנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ. וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵינוּ קָרָאתָ:
uncertainties: The start of אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּנוּ is above band 3 and is not in the supplied images. Only the descenders of the line before are visible at the top edge of the band, so the opening words (from אתה בחרתנו to the word before מַלְכֵּנוּ) cannot be transcribed from these bands.

blocks.text: וַתִּתֶּן־לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה אֶת־יוֹם (הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְאֶת יוֹם) הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה. יוֹם (זִכְרוֹן) תְּרוּעָה (בְּאַהֲבָה) מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ זֵכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָיִם:
uncertainties: The three bracketed passages are in smaller type, so the pointing on (הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה / וְאֶת יוֹם) and (זִכְרוֹן) is hard to read. It may be partial.
The Divine Name is printed as יְיָ (two yods, pointed).

blocks.region: band3 lines 5-8 continuing into band4 lines 1-4
blocks.text: וּמִפְּנֵי חֲטָאֵינוּ גָּלִינוּ מֵאַרְצֵנוּ וְנִתְרַחַקְנוּ מֵעַל אַדְמָתֵנוּ וְאֵין אֲנַחְנוּ יְכוֹלִים לַעֲשׂוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵינוּ בְּבֵית בְּחִירָתֶךָ בַּבַּיִת הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁנִּקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלָיו מִפְּנֵי הַיָּד שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּלְּחָה בְּמִקְדָּשֶׁךָ: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ רַחֲמָן שֶׁתָּשׁוּב וּתְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים וְתִבְנֵהוּ מְהֵרָה וּתְגַדֵּל כְּבוֹדוֹ:
uncertainties: The last line of band 3 (הַיָּד שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּלְּחָה …) is cut off at the band edge. I read it from band 4, where it is repeated in full.
The vowels in חוֹבוֹתֵינוּ and the sheva under the shin of מִקְדָּשְׁךָ are small. My reading is likely correct but not certain.

blocks.region: band4 line 4 (last text line on page)
blocks.text: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ גַּלֵּה כְּבוֹד־מַלְכוּתְךָ עָלֵינוּ מְהֵרָה וְהוֹפַע
uncertainties: The sentence breaks off mid-clause at the foot of the page and continues on 254.

blocks.text: Thou hast chosen us from all peoples, loved us and found delight in us and exalted us above all tongues and sanctified us through Thy commandments, and brought us near, O our King, to Thy service and proclaimed Thy great and holy Name unto us.

Thou hast given us, O Lord our God, in love this day (of the Sabbath and this day) of remembrance, a day (of remembrance) of Teruah (in love) for a sacred convocation, a reminder of the exodus from Egypt.
uncertainties: The page hyphenates "convoca-tion" across a line break. I joined it as "convocation".

blocks.region: band3 lines 10-13 continuing into band4 lines 1-7
blocks.text: Because of our sins we were exiled from our land and removed from our soil and we are unable to fulfil our duties in the House of Thy choice upon which Thy Name has been called, because of the hand that was stretched out against Thy sanctuary. May it be pleasing to Thee, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, O compassionate King, that Thou mayest again, in Thine abundant mercies, have compassion on us and on Thy sanctuary and rebuild it speedily and add to its glory. Our Father, our King, speedily reveal the glory of Thy Kingdom to us and appear and be exalted over us before the eyes
uncertainties: The page hyphenates "King-dom" across a line break. I joined it as "Kingdom".
The page spells it "fulfil" (British spelling). I kept that spelling.
The text breaks off mid-sentence ("before the eyes") and continues on 255.
